cues: The iodoform test is not a test for alcohols in general.
It works only for ethanol and alcohols with the C H three C H O H group, like propan two ol, and for methyl ketones.
Methanol and propan one ol give no yellow precipitate.
text: A favourite trap. The iodoform test is not a test for alcohols in general. It works only for ethanol and alcohols with the C H three C H O H group, like propan two ol, and for methyl ketones. Methanol and propan one ol give no yellow precipitate.
